nodes.asset_description: A computer monitor displaying a website titled “Savoir-Vivre Choise” sits on a white desk. A person’s legs, wearing striped socks and jeans, are crossed at the ankles in front of the monitor. A green and white mug rests on the desk beside the monitor. Above the monitor, two wooden shelves hold books, a vintage radio, and a framed photo. The wall behind the shelves is white with visible texture.

A young woman with long red hair and glasses sits cross-legged on a patterned rug, wearing a pale yellow long-sleeved shirt and pink pants. She holds a blue pen in her right hand and looks down at a black laptop computer resting on her lap. A closed spiral-bound notebook lies beside her, and a black tablet is positioned to the left. A black leather couch is visible in the background, along with a wooden table and a lamp.

An orange, glossy mushroom-shaped lamp sits atop a stack of three books on a dark brown wooden surface. The lamp has a rounded, bulbous base and a wide, flat top. A white cord extends from the left side of the lamp. The top book is dark blue with visible text, and the bottom two books are white with visible text. A small, black and white photograph rests on the bottom book. A small, white, diamond-shaped object is visible in the bottom right corner of the image.

A person wearing a white long-sleeved shirt is seated at a wooden table, typing on a silver laptop. The laptop screen displays a recipe image featuring a bowl of orange-colored food. A bright orange bowl filled with oranges sits on the table next to the laptop. To the left of the laptop, a closed book rests on the table. The background is blurred and out of focus.
